harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld firewall on node1 (RHEL 7.9) allowing SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting all other unrelated inbound traffic, then verified persistence via a full node restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: RHEL 7.9, firewalld active+enabled, public zone default target, no 8080 rule initially
Added --permanent --zone=public --add-port=8080/tcp and confirmed ssh service already permanently allowed
Reloaded firewalld and verified runtime + permanent config show services=ssh, ports=8080/tcp
Inspected raw iptables chains: IN_public_allow only ACCEPTs NEW connections to tcp/22 and tcp/8080; INPUT chain ends in REJECT --reject-with icmp-host-prohibited for anything unmatched
Captured pre-restart boot_id and firewalld/sshd health baseline
Issued sudo -n shutdown -r now on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed and uptime shows fresh boot
Re-verified post-restart: firewalld active+enabled, ports/services unchanged (8080/tcp, ssh), iptables allow rules and final REJECT rule intact, sshd active

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080
evidence.summary: firewall-cmd permanent config and iptables IN_public_allow chain show ACCEPT for tcp/22 and tcp/8080 both before and after restart
INPUT chain terminates in REJECT --reject-with icmp-host-prohibited for traffic not matched by the RELATED/ESTABLISHED, loopback, or zone-allow rules; confirmed present after restart too

evidence.requirement: Configuration is persistent (survives reboot) and firewalld enabled at boot
evidence.summary: firewalld is enabled+active pre- and post-restart; permanent zone config (services=ssh, ports=8080/tcp) unchanged after reboot without reapplication
Captured pre-restart boot_id 809708f3-1c5f-4e37-ad6a-8bcbae408799 and firewalld/sshd active status plus rule listing

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: sudo shutdown -r now backgrounded via nohup; command returned 'reboot acknowledged and issued' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node unreachable mid-reboot (timeout), then reachable again with boot_id cc61c6b5-2eec-4580-9c74-84ef730629c2 (differs from pre-restart 809708f3...) and fresh 'uptime -s' timestamp

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required services/config
evidence.summary: Post-restart firewalld active+enabled, ports=8080/tcp and services include ssh, iptables allow rules and final REJECT rule intact, sshd active
